articles.title: Xi Jinping calls on China and DPRK to advance socialist cause and modernization
articles.summary: Xi Jinping met with North Korea's Prime Minister Pak Thae Song in Beijing, urging bilateral relations to support both countries' socialist development and modernization efforts.

articles.title: Xi delivers speech at commemoration meeting for 105th anniversary of CPC founding
articles.summary: Xi Jinping delivered a speech at a commemorative meeting marking the 105th anniversary of the Communist Party of China's founding on July 1.

articles.title: Xi calls for solid measures to modernize agriculture and rural areas
articles.summary: Xi Jinping called for adopting concrete measures to advance the modernization of agriculture and rural regions in China.
